intro: Technology and software development led the impact of 35 remote code execution incidents tracked between April and August 2026, with government, manufacturing, and research also affected globally, particularly in Asia, China, and Russia. PhantomCore was observed among the activity. The severity mix included 22 critical and 12 high cases, with one medium. Key vulnerabilities exploited were CVE-2026-20223 (CVSS 10), CVE-2025-54987, CVE-2026-22679, CVE-2026-31251, and CVE-2026-45033, each rated 9.8.
